patch_description: Crossover of the current best program (heuristic-seeded beam search with wider beams, randomized greedy with lookahead, top-6 candidate pool, 25s budget) with the first inspiration program's richer local search neighborhood. The key improvement is adding or-opt block moves (relocate contiguous segments of size 2–3) and 2-opt segment reversals to the first-improvement insertion/swap local search. These larger neighborhood moves escape local optima that plain insertion/swap cannot, while the perturbation restarts continue to diversify the search. The best-scoring components of each parent are retained: heuristic seeding and beam widths from the current program, extended move set from the inspiration program.
